market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool under Arne Slot are on track to win the 2024‑25 Premier League, showing exceptional depth and tactical solidity. Despite uncertainties around expiring contracts for Salah, Van Dijk, and Alexander‑Arnold, the club’s strong recruitment and the continuity of a successful system make a top‑4 finish in 2025‑26 highly likely. Their recent consistency (only one top‑4 miss in the last eight seasons) supports a ~75% probability, well above the market’s 52.5%.
evidence_points: Currently leading the 2024‑25 EPL with a large margin, indicating a dominant side
Arne Slot’s system has produced high‑level performances without reliance on a single star
Even if key veterans leave, Liverpool’s financial power and scouting can secure adequate replacements
Historical record: only one finish outside top 4 in the past eight completed seasons
sources_consulted: Recent Liverpool match reports and squad analysis
